"Nearly every major expansion of government power over private life and personal information in recent decades has been sold with some version of 'we must save the children.' The KIDS Act is simply the latest iteration of this approach."


Christopher Skelly (@Skelly4Liberty)

Proponents frame the KIDS act as essential protection for children by requiring age verification on adult websites. The appeal is emotional and familiar: who would stand against shielding kids from harmful online content?
